source: NESO EAC auction results (Dynamic Containment, Moderation, Regulation)
method: mean clearing price of each service over the period, Low + High frequency sides stacked for one symmetric MW, weighted by cleared volume across DC/DM/DR, x 8,760 h, x participation share = mean cleared MW / GB operational battery MW (REPD); same for every duration
derivation: GBP/MW/h (L+H): DC 4.78, DM 7.18, DR 8.90; mean cleared MW: DC 1,190, DM 521, DR 489; volume-weighted 6.26 GBP/MW/h; share 2,200 MW / 4,956 MW = 0.444 (REPD https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a6cbdc00c36759b5ccaa305/REPD_Publication_Q2_2026.csv: 150 of 178 Operational Battery records carry MW, so the fleet is undercounted and the share is high); 6.26 x 8760 x 0.444 = GBP 24,353/MW/yr; resources 596f29ac-0387-4ba4-a6d3-95c243140707, be55ee51-b79e-47da-b71e-a0f8865d9d66
note: Snapshot of the live computation on 2026-09-27 (bessible.market.refresh). Served only when the live source fails, and then flagged cached.
